_comment: Pointer-up commits clone (§R2-F SC-076). Simulates the Inspector Clone flow (cloneNode → setViewMode('galaxy') → setDraggingNode(newId)), drives pointermove so the GalaxyCloneDragLayer resolves nearestHubId, then dispatches pointerup. After pointer-up: clone.parentHubId is set to the resolved hub; intent.caption carries the new hub-title prefix; draggingNodeId/draggingNearestHubId/draggingPointerWorld all clear.

steps.js: (() => { const set = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_SET_VIEW_MODE__; if (typeof set === 'function') set('canvas'); return 'canvas'; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const node = src.nodes[0]; const sourceParent = node.parentHubId; const newId = src.cloneNode(node.nodeId); ed.setViewMode('galaxy'); ed.setEditorRenderMode('topology'); ed.setDraggingNode(newId); ed.selectNode(newId); window.__EBR2_F_05_CLONE_ID__ = newId; window.__EBR2_F_05_SOURCE_PARENT__ = sourceParent; return { newId, sourceParent }; })()

(() => { const ed = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__.graphEditor.getState(); return ed.viewMode === 'galaxy' && typeof ed.draggingNodeId === 'string' && ed.draggingNodeId === window.__EBR2_F_05_CLONE_ID__; })()

(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); if (!canvas) return null; const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = rect.left + rect.width * 0.7; const cy = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) { canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: cx + i, clientY: cy + i, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 })); } return { cx, cy }; })()
(() => { const ed = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__.graphEditor.getState(); return typeof ed.draggingNearestHubId === 'string' && ed.draggingNearestHubId.length > 0; })()

(() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = rect.left + rect.width * 0.7; const cy = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; window.__EBR2_F_05_RESOLVED_HUB__ = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__.graphEditor.getState().draggingNearestHubId; canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: cx, clientY: cy, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 })); return window.__EBR2_F_05_RESOLVED_HUB__; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const cloneId = window.__EBR2_F_05_CLONE_ID__; const hubId = window.__EBR2_F_05_RESOLVED_HUB__; if (!cloneId || !hubId) return false; const clone = src.nodes.find((n) => n.nodeId === cloneId); if (!clone) return false; return ed.draggingNodeId === null && ed.draggingNearestHubId === null && ed.draggingPointerWorld === null && clone.parentHubId === hubId && typeof clone.intent.caption === 'string' && /\(clone\)$/.test(clone.intent.caption); })()
